title: “வெற்றி நமது” – Student Guidance Programme at Shine Auditorium
content: Sri Shanmugha Educational Institutions proudly organized “வெற்றி நமது (Vetri Namadhu)”, an inspiring student guidance programme aimed at empowering learners with clarity on higher education pathways and career direction. The session featured Dr. Kandasamy Prabakar as the Chief Guest.
